updates.title: GAID 2025 Now Effective: New Compliance Obligations for DCPMIs
updates.summary: The General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2025 is now in effect. It operationalizes the NDP Act 2023 with detailed requirements for DCPMI registration, compliance audit returns, data protection impact assessments, and breach notification procedures.

changes.after: Comprehensive implementation framework with specific compliance deadlines

compliance_actions: Review DCPMI classification thresholds (UHL: >10,000 data subjects or sensitive data)
Prepare for annual Compliance Audit Returns filing by March 31st
Engage licensed DPCO for compliance audit certification
Update breach response procedures per GAID specifications
updates.official_reference: NDPC issued GAID 2025 on September 19, 2025, effective immediately

updates.title: CBN AML/CFT Regulations 2022 - Full Implementation Required
updates.summary: The CBN AML/CFT Regulations for Banks and Other Financial Institutions in Nigeria, 2022, issued under the Money Laundering (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022, require enhanced customer due diligence, suspicious transaction reporting to NFIU within 24 hours, enterprise-wide risk assessments, and independent compliance audits.

changes.after: Enhanced AML/CFT Regulations 2022 with stricter requirements

compliance_actions: Implement Customer Due Diligence with BVN/NIN verification
Maintain transaction records for minimum 5 years
updates.official_reference: CBN AML/CFT Regulations 2022, issued pursuant to Money Laundering (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022

updates.title: NDPC Guidance on AI and Automated Decision-Making Under Development
updates.summary: NDPC has announced it is developing comprehensive guidance on the application of Section 37 of the NDP Act 2023 regarding automated decision-making and AI systems. The guidance will address transparency, human intervention, and explainability requirements for AI-driven decisions affecting data subjects.

changes.before: General right not to be subject to automated decisions
changes.after: Specific guidance on meaningful human intervention and explainability expected

compliance_actions: Monitor NDPC website for published AI guidance
Prepare to implement human review options for automated decisions
Review privacy policies for AI disclosure requirements
updates.official_reference: NDPC announced AI guidance development at stakeholder engagement on November 10, 2025

updates.title: NDP Act 2023 - Full Legal Framework for Nigerian Data Protection
updates.summary: The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 establishes the legal framework for data protection in Nigeria, creating the NDPC as the independent regulatory authority. Key provisions include lawful basis for processing, consent requirements, data subject rights, DPO appointment, breach notification, and DCPMI registration.

changes.after: NDP Act 2023 (primary legislation with enhanced enforcement powers)

compliance_actions: Implement consent mechanisms meeting Section 26 requirements
Determine DCPMI status and registration requirements
updates.official_reference: NDP Act 2023 signed into law June 12, 2023

affected_controls_summary.note: This summary reflects a typical Nigerian startup's compliance posture before implementing remediation measures
